decision: Close branch: fixed Gibbs rescue fails convergence; no additional sweeps, adaptive gate, CV or candidate.
scope: Source-only numerical study; no departure labels or CV scores.

design.prior: retained v70 means, original training quantiles/copy/broad support; no public-input networks
design.likelihood: variance-matched multivariate t5 with peer moments and shared-flight covariance
design.measurement: retained taxi2 covariance plus retained departure t3 scale converted to variance
design.calendars: own local takeoff runway cell; own once-estimated UTC off-block day
design.comparison: joint posterior mean minus matched departure-only moment posterior mean
design.transfer: one fixed half incremental correction through current v77 constraints
design.common_error: one shared15-second mean perturbation across the selected two cohorts
design.scope: source-only numerical pilot; no labels or scores
design.change: exact single-site Gibbs conditional, systematic sorted-ID sweep
design.selection: smallest, median-rank, largest peer-count cohorts of the frozen24-target input pilot; ties sortedmonth/targetID
design.sampling: independent inverse-CDF Sobol dimensions in ascending movement-ID order, all retained support values/weights
design.projection: one sampled flight value jointly drives every taxi/delay component it belongs to
design.target: exact conditional mean/probability at end of each complete sweep
design.remainder: subtract ALL masked long-peer means/covariances including target once; retain original ordinary/source/common15sec covariance
design.convergence: joint/dep/increment two-scramble and nested-N differences; target-marginal likelihood ESS
design.limitation: local marginal integration only; does not jointly condition overlapping cohort factors
design.randomness: predeclared independent chain uniforms, reused across separate joint and departure-only kernels
design.numerical_success: both budgets all3cohorts: rank/folded split Rhat<=1.01, bulkESS>=400 for nonconstant diagnostics; increment change<=max(1sec,2 combined MCSE); no CV allowed on failure
design.escalation: one pilot; no more sweeps/chains or modified gate if convergence fails
